accepted.sentence: Hardwood handles are formed from dense timber, with wood grain visible along their outer surfaces.
On impact-rated versions, a metal butt cap is built into the handle's rear end.
A freely turning end cap allows fingertip control while the handle body remains cradled in the palm.
Some steel shafts have a black oxide surface finish that offers limited corrosion resistance.
A square-section shaft has four flat longitudinal faces and a distinct angular cross-section.
Chrome plating gives some metal shafts a bright, smooth exterior surface.
Certain handles have an oval cross-section rather than a circular one, shaping how they sit in the hand.
In full-tang construction, the metal core runs through the handle to its rear end.
